outcome_definition: Respondent reports having been told by a doctor that they have diabetes (not prediabetes), at the time of the survey.
population_note: Training data covers US adults who answered a 2015 telephone health survey. All answers are self-reported. It describes who already reports a diabetes diagnosis, so it cannot find undiagnosed diabetes, and it is not validated outside the US.
